questions.question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. V has the exam on Saturday. Only 2 people have their exams between T and R. R has the exam immediately before V. U has the exam immediately after Q. P does not have the exam after R. Who has the exam on Monday?
In a certain code language,‘A + B’ means ‘A is the son of B’,‘A ^ B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and‘A % B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.If ‘X ^ Y + Z ^ A + B’, how is Z related to X?

Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?# : MHN :: LGM : %2870
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (# = JEK, % = OJP) है।

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:Some stars are planets.No planet is a river.All rivers are valleys.Conclusions:I. Some valleys are planets.II. Some rivers are stars.3339
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: Tanmay starts from point A and drives 12 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km, takes a left turn and drives 2 km. He takes a final left turn and drives 9 km and stops at point B. Nitin starts from point P, which is 22 km east of Point A, and drives 9 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final right turn and drives 18 km and stops at Point Q. What is the shortest distance between Point Q and Point B? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statement:Almost every third person living in the states of Region S lives below the poverty line.Conclusions:I. Continent A, where Region S is situated, is regarded as the poorest continent on the planet.II. The desert in Region S has a very hot and humid climate, making life there extremely difficult.
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither conclusion I nor II follows.) है।

Which numbers should replace X and Y so that the pattern followed by the two numbers on the left side of :: is same as that on the right side of ::?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct answer.Statements:I) Anil’s wealth has been decreasing over the last six months.II) Anil has been spending a lot of money buying cars over the last six months.
options: Both I and II are independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (II is the cause and I is its possible effect.) है।
